requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation is completely missing from the codebase. All tests in test_hook_h2.py are failing because the HTTP/2 functionality is not implemented.
requirement.contract: Implement a new HTTP/2 hook module that intercepts HTTP/2 requests/responses made via httpx and records them in the same manner as HTTP/1 requests. The hook should support both synchronous and asynchronous clients and handle all HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.). It should properly extract request/response data including headers, cookies, content, status codes, and protocols.
